description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Rescheduling functionality in Apache Fineract, specifically covering scenarios involving down payments, multiple disbursements, and interest considerations. It extends a base test class and uses various helper classes to create loan products, apply loans, verify repayment schedules, transactions, and journal entries.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleTestWithDownpayment
classes.description: Integration tests for loan rescheduling scenarios involving down payments, multiple disbursements, and interest rate adjustments in Apache Fineract.
